title: Practice 4: Two verbs for every way of going

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Он хорошо ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) верхом.
exercises.why: **ездит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.prompt: He is good at riding a horse.

exercises.q: Мой дядя ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) на форде.
exercises.why: **ездит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Летом я часто ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) на дачу.
exercises.why: **езжу** — present tense (1st person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.prompt: In the summer, I often go to my country house.

exercises.q: На этом велике ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) мой брат.
exercises.why: **ездит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.prompt: This bike is used by my brother.

exercises.q: В настоящее время люди не ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) на повозке.
exercises.why: **ездят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.prompt: Nowadays people don't ride in carriages.

exercises.q: Паровозы ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) менее плавно, чем электропоезда.
exercises.why: **ездят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.prompt: Steam locomotives run less smoothly than electric trains.

exercises.q: Я часто ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) на остров Менорка и на остров Ибица.
exercises.why: **езжу** — present tense (1st person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.prompt: I frequently go to the islands of Menorca and Ibiza.

exercises.q: В дебюте ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general) только те пешки, которые помогают фигурам развиваться.
exercises.why: **ходите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: In the opening, move only those pawns that help develop the pieces.

exercises.q: Зимой в Шамони много снега, и люди ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) туда кататься на лыжах.
exercises.why: **ездят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.prompt: There is a lot of snow in Chamonix in the winter and people go skiing there.

exercises.q: По этой дороге ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) всё реже, и она постепенно зарастает травой.
exercises.why: **ездят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.prompt: This road is driven on less and less, and it is slowly becoming overgrown with grass.

exercises.q: И ___ (лететь — to fly, one way) чашка.
exercises.why: **летит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).

exercises.q: А, ты ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way)?
exercises.why: **идешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) к царю!
exercises.why: **идут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Как он ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way)!
exercises.why: **идет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) за ним.
exercises.why: **иду** — present tense (1st person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Да не ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way)!.
exercises.why: **идет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Они идут, ___ (лететь — to fly, one way).
exercises.why: **летят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).

exercises.q: Как ты ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way)!
exercises.why: **идешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (лететь — to fly, one way) стая уток.
exercises.why: **летит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).

exercises.q: Вот он ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way).
exercises.why: **идёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
